Engine sound-alikes: أبو = أول (12:30), هدية = حديقة (13:01, 47:38), الأرض = إرد (13:50, 42:38), سنعجب = سناجب, حسن = حصان/حُصُن, الشاة = الشارع, أمامتي = حمامتي, ذي رو بالو = دير بالو, بيشغلي = بيشكولي, سار = صار, بدا = بيضا (17:22), أبي للدرس = قبل الدرس (11:30). rows.why: He put a wrong ending on the verb (-iini) for the object 'me'; Amal recast it as بيسألني and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: امشي. [يسعل] اه، يرجعوا شمس بس بارد.
rows.why: The sun is a known thing and needs el- (and a she-verb); Amal's question echoed it back as الشمس - a soft recast, may be just her question.
rows.english: the sun came back but it's cold

rows.amal_said: You said it right the first time.
rows.why: Telling the time takes the feminine number; Amal said his first try was right, so the changed form (engine wrote تنين) was the slip - engine text is unclear.

rows.amal_said: ابعت. What does ابعت take? ... No. ابعت does. Send to me.
rows.why: Homework review: he wrote ابعت with no لـ ('I thought it doesn't take anything'); Amal said No, ابعت takes لـ (send to me).
For 'white' (plural, cats) he said بيوت/سابيو; Amal said No, it is بيض - wrong form of أبيض (sheet: white (m/f) | Abyad | أبيض).

rows.amal_said: But what do we need before بيض? ... Because it's بساسك. It's definitive.
rows.why: Adjective after a definite (possessed) noun needs el-; Amal prompted 'what do we need before بيض?' and he added الـ.

rows.medi_said: هذي، um, no هذا، هذا الـ-- Yeah.
rows.why: Homework review: he wrote هذي with masculine عصفور; Amal pointed it out ('you put هذي'); in speech he had already fixed it, so this is the written slip.

rows.medi_said: اللي، oh، إن-- اللي and home يا.
rows.why: For 'that we have' he said a garbled form with a loose يا; Amal said No and gave اللي عندنا (ending on عند); he admitted he forgot the ending.

rows.medi_said: أبو الحيوان ... أبو الحيوان أنا أفكر فيه
rows.why: Engine wrote أبو for أول; awal + el- + noun means 'the beginning of', 'the first animal' is أول حيوان; Amal let it pass.
rows.english: the first animal I think of

rows.why: Plain present verb needs b-: بفكر; Amal let it pass.
Zoo is حديقة الحيوانات (owner takes el-); he said it without el- (engine wrote هدية for حديقة); Amal let it pass.

rows.amal_said: أرض، إرد. Because إرد is قـ is usually قرد يعني قرد. بس أرض is أ originally أ.
rows.why: Answering 'monkey' (Amal's hint) he said الأرض (earth); Amal separated أرض (earth) from إرد/قرد (monkey) - sheet: monkey | 2erd | قرد.
He was talking about fish he had in the past with plain عندي; Amal said 'I had' and he said كان عندي.

rows.medi_said: and I كان عندي arba- سمك.
rows.amal_said: سمك. Now it's plural بس مش general يعني. ... سمكات.
rows.why: After a number 3-10 the noun takes the counted plural; Amal said سمك is general, not for numbers, and gave سمكات.
The fish (سمكة) is feminine, so the verb is كانت; Amal recast كانت.
Feminine سمكة takes the feminine adjective; Amal repeated كانت and he moved to بدا (engine for بيضا).

rows.amal_said: هلأ إحنا بنحكي عن سمكة so ... أخيرة.
rows.why: 'The last one' for a fish (feminine) is الأخيرة; Amal pointed to سمكة and gave أخيرة; he said الأخيرة.

rows.amal_said: Or you could say آخر واحدة.
rows.why: Amal offered آخر واحدة; he said it back with el- (الآخر = the end of), and she let it pass.

rows.amal_said: لون. هه؟ ... أسود. 'Cause now we're describing the لون.
rows.why: The adjective agrees with لون (masculine), not the fish; Amal gave أسود and named why.
Animals in general take el-; Amal said (كل) الحيوانات and he said ما أحبوا الحيوانات في البيت.
rows.english: my family didn't like animals in the house

rows.why: A lasting past dislike is kaan + present (ما كانوا يحبوا); Amal let it pass.
rows.english: my family didn't use to like animals at home

rows.why: He used the you-(fem) past ending -ti for 'I looked'; Amal said 'You, not me' and he said اتطلعت.
rows.english: the last animal I looked at

rows.amal_said: Before, before can. What is it? طلعت. What does طلع take؟
rows.why: Look at = اتطلع على; he left out the preposition and Amal prompted 'what does طلع take?', he said على.
Didn't-know: he could not find the word for tail; Amal supplied ذيل.
'When I was small' needs the I-ending كنت; Amal started to cut in and he said لما كنت صغير at the same moment - may be his own fix.

rows.medi_said: and this is feminine كان عندها
rows.why: He wanted 'she didn't have a tail' (after مش ديل); Amal said ما and he said مكان عندها.
'By mistake' is بالغلط (bi + el- + noun); he said a verb form بيغلط; Amal recast and he repeated.
Other than / different from is غير عن; he said غير من then غير البس, Amal said عن and he said 'that's right'.
بشتاق takes لـ (he had just said بشتا لا سمكاتي); here it is missing - may be the engine dropping لـ.
'The animals I see most' is present (bashuf); he used past shufit; Amal said 'You see, not saw'.
After bi the street keeps el-; Amal recast (engine wrote الشاة) and he said El shaara.
Didn't-know: he paused ('Is it,') and Amal supplied the plural سناجب (engine wrote سنعجب); he repeated Sanajib.
Wrong plural pattern for street; Amal said No and gave شوارع (sheet: street | Shaare3 | شارع).

rows.amal_said: حسن. ... Yes, حسن is one, حسن is multiple.
rows.why: Asked for plurals, he gave the singular حصان; Amal gave the plural (engine wrote حسن for حُصُن) and explained one vs many.

rows.amal_said: One animal. ... Why would you put a T? Is it feminine?
rows.why: He put a feminine -t on the masculine noun حيوان; Amal asked why the T, he said حيواني.
'My second favorite' = حيواني المفضل التاني; he put التاني before المفضل and Amal said 'Flip it'.

rows.amal_said: No, you don't even need the مفضل ... مفضل عندي ... No El.
rows.why: After indefinite تاني حيوان the adjective takes no el-; Amal said No and 'No El'.
Prefer X over Y = بفضل X على Y; Amal said La and he said على إشي.

rows.medi_said: لا بتستنى لا. No. بتستنى الجاجات.
rows.why: 'Her chickens' needs the possessive ending, not el-; Amal said No, 'her chickens'.

rows.why: 'Invited' is past; he used the present بيعزم, Amal said 'Invited' and he said عزموني.
In idafa the first word (حديقة) takes no el-; he put الـ before it (engine garbled); Amal let it pass.

rows.amal_said: Mm-mm. ... What's another verb like that can portray...
rows.why: Ask (someone) = طلب من; he tried لـ, Amal said Mm-mm and hinted, he said من.

rows.amal_said: No. ... It's present. ... Yes, so no be 'cause it's talabit.
rows.why: After طلبت من the next verb is a bare present (يدير); he said the command form دير (engine ذي رو), then بدير with b-; Amal said No, present, then no b-.

rows.amal_said: Where's the bee؟ ... ببعت so bee is part of the verb.
rows.why: 'Sent' is بعت, not أعطى (gave); Amal asked where the ب is and he switched to بعثوا.
بعت takes لـ for the receiver (Amal: 'send to me'), and 'us' is لنا not لي; he ended on بعثونا and Amal let it pass.
Engine wrote أمامتي; Amal's voiced 54:54 'Other than this حمامتي one' shows he said حمامتي - a feminine -t on masculine حمام (sheet: bathroom | 7ammaam | حمام).
Adjective after a possessed (definite) noun takes el-: خروفي المريض; Amal recast المريض.

For 'a while' he groped to فاتح (a different word); Amal supplied فترة.
